definitions.explanation: A formal or earnest request for something to be done. Stronger and more formal than お{願|ねが}い, often used when making requests to authorities, organizations, or in official contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要望|ようぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|こた}える→応える：09893_kotaeru⟧。
{要望|ようぼう}{書|しょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}した→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。

⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要望|ようぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧⟦{寄|よ}せられた→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{出|だ}した→乗り出す：05760_noridasu⟧。
examples.english: Because numerous requests for noise countermeasures were received from residents, the city launched an investigation.

notes:
USAGE:
{要望|ようぼう} is a formal word typically used when requesting something from an organization, government, or person in authority. It implies a strong, earnest desire and is more formal and weighty than ⟦{依頼|いらい}→依頼：02594_irai⟧ (commission/request) or ⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧ (request/favor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {要望|ようぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|こた}える→応える：09893_kotaeru⟧ (respond to a request)
- {要望|ようぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (put forward a request)
- {要望|ようぼう}{書|しょ} (written request, petition)
- {要望|ようぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ (many requests)
- {要望|ようぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (receive a request)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{要求|ようきゅう}→要求：03658_youkyuu⟧: demand (stronger, more insistent)
- ⟦{依頼|いらい}→依頼：02594_irai⟧: request, commission (asking someone to do something)
- ⟦{要請|ようせい}→要請：05463_yousei⟧: request, appeal (formal, often from one organization to another)
